bar-default.description: Settled Bar, no media, empty first slot (tiling absent).

bar-fade-initial.description: Surface motion at its initial frame (opacity 0), before the 0.275s fade.

global-suspense.description: A status query is pending: the root Suspense (fallback null) renders nothing.

global-error.description: ErrorBoundary fallback (QueryErrorFallback) after a rejected query.
global-error.wide: Something went wrong
global-error.compact: Something went wrong

spaces-fallback.description: Spaces suspended: SpacesFallback "Loading..." Surface in the first slot.
spaces-fallback.wide: Loading...
spaces-fallback.compact: Loading...

media-artwork-loaded.description: Artwork preloaded: 24x24 radius-10 image before the icon.

media-artwork-error.description: Artwork present but failed to load (loadedArtwork null): no image.

media-long-title.description: Long title, label not (yet) scrolling: clipped at max-width 560/400px.

media-long-title-scrolling.description: Long title with injected ScrollingLabel state (scroll-text animation).

cpu-threshold-85.description: At the 85 threshold: red CpuCharge icon.

wifi-long-ssid-scrolling.description: Long SSID with injected scrolling state.

weather-error.description: Configured, not loading, no data (failed): "Loading..." with default icon.

spaces-workspaces-no-focus.description: Every legacy workspace icon, none focused (no indicator), no apps.

spaces-workspace-focused-terminal.description: Every legacy workspace icon; terminal focused (indicator), the rest unfocused.

spaces-workspace-focused-coding.description: Every legacy workspace icon; coding focused (indicator), the rest unfocused.

spaces-workspace-focused-browser.description: Every legacy workspace icon; browser focused (indicator), the rest unfocused.

spaces-workspace-focused-music.description: Every legacy workspace icon; music focused (indicator), the rest unfocused.

spaces-workspace-focused-design.description: Every legacy workspace icon; design focused (indicator), the rest unfocused.

spaces-workspace-focused-communication.description: Every legacy workspace icon; communication focused (indicator), the rest unfocused.

spaces-workspace-focused-guitar.description: Every legacy workspace icon; guitar focused (indicator), the rest unfocused.

spaces-workspace-focused-misc.description: Every legacy workspace icon; misc focused (indicator), the rest unfocused.

spaces-workspace-focused-files.description: Every legacy workspace icon; files focused (indicator), the rest unfocused.

spaces-workspace-focused-tasks.description: Every legacy workspace icon; tasks focused (indicator), the rest unfocused.

spaces-unknown-workspace.description: Unknown workspace names sort last alphabetically; the focused unknown one has the indicator and no icon (approved deviation).

spaces-app-icons-1.description: App icons 1-10 of the app map (unfocused, no focused app).

spaces-app-icons-2.description: App icons 11-20 of the app map (unfocused, no focused app).

spaces-app-icons-3.description: App icons 21-30 of the app map (unfocused, no focused app).

spaces-app-icons-4.description: App icons 31-40 of the app map (unfocused, no focused app).

spaces-app-focused.description: Focused app shows its label; laptop widths reduce the list to the focused app only.

spaces-two-apps.description: The spaces-app-focused strip after its last app (Safari) closed: the app exit end state.

spaces-duplicate-titles.description: Duplicate app names show window titles; the focused long title is cut at 40 + "..." (laptop: focused only, app name).

spaces-duplicate-unicode.description: Duplicate app names; the focused Unicode title is cut at 40 + "...".

spaces-duplicate-no-focus.description: Duplicate app names without a focused app: titles are derived (25 on laptop widths) but no label is drawn.

spaces-absent.description: Tiling not enabled: the empty first-slot div in the full Bar.

spaces-empty.description: Tiling enabled with zero workspaces: the empty first-slot div in the full Bar.

spaces-with-media.description: Strip, centred media and status together in the full Bar layout.
